doc: What bounds a dispatching run. Checked against the run ledger, not against what a caller says, and kept inside the evaluator fence so a dispatched run cannot raise its own ceiling.

depth.why: A run that starts a run that starts a run is three runs' spend under one label. Depth is counted from the ledger.

wall_clock.why: Thirty minutes for a whole tree of dispatches. A child inherits what is left of its parent's time.

cost.why: Binds on what the adapters report. A cost that was not reported is recorded as unknown, and such a run is bounded by depth and time alone.
